description: No clean concept found. Weak tendency: fires more often when the opponent owns bottom-row stones on the right half (cells in columns 3-6 of row 0 hold two or more of their stones and none of mine), in early or mid game with column 6 still low; this captures only a small part of firing. Firing depends on specific stone combinations, and making a cell in row 3 playable usually switches it off.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to zero or to its maximum changes move probabilities by at most about 0.03.
notes: 5 scored hypotheses (O at (0,3)+low col 6; row-2/row-3 landing cells; open bottom-right window for opponent; weighted O-cell count; O at (0,6) with open row) all gave F1 0.06-0.09, AUROC ~0.5; best was the bottom-right window rule (F1 0.088, sim share 0.29). Activation is board-based but highly conjunctive (moving one stone in 6,6,1,2,2 kills it). Steering has no effect. Likely a random direction or a mixture. Best synthesis 4.097, just below dev max 4.169.
